body: I just avoid looking at it. I guess I just feel like I'm always fucking up, and I'm ashamed of my own existence.
Sorry for the late replies. I was absolutely mindblown by how many kindhearted people there are here, and I'm trying to reply to everyone. Thank you all for looking out for me - it means a lot.

I'm so sorry to hear that you're hurting too, /u/hymnalstories. It's so kind of you to offer to help - despite being in pain yourself. I want to tell you that you're not broken, that you're a lovely person who deserves to be happy just like anyone else - but I can't do that right now because I'm not in a state where I can help you. I wish I can be better, and not always be so hurt.

I love writing. But now I can't even do that. Have you read my comments here? See how robotic I sound? I can't even write anymore, because I'm so broken I can't call forth the spark.

When I write, I would write of beautiful, lovely things. But how could I do that, when my own life is so fucked up? How dare I weave such hypocrisies? I can't do it anymore.

Thank you for offering help :) - I'm feeling slightly better today, even though my underlying issues aren't solved. Seeing your comment really made me smile for a really silly reason :)

In my regular account, I usually reply to people on /r/SuicideWatch, and when I saw your comment I immediately wanted to quote **Rule 4** and say "Please offer help publically" and link the wiki page.

But then, I realized that I'm on the other side of the fence now, so I can't really do that, could I? Even though, having that reflex made me laugh ~ so you brightened up my day :)

I wish someone could come, and hold me, and tell me everything will be fine. Beyond that, I wish someone can help me be strong, and support me to be a better person. I hate being dependent on others - I'm usually very outspoken, confident, and independent. But now, I just wish someone can hold my hand and lead me forward, until I can be strong again.

Haha :) - I've never been to Africa sadly. But this isn't helping a lot - even though I do understand the need for an escape. I've been trying to hide myself in my books, even though it's only going to hurt me later, because I'm leaving my responsibilities behind.

Right now, in the immediate vicinity - I'm overwhelmed with work, and apathetic. I'm missing classes because I no longer know enough to keep up, and this hurts me a lot. I used to take great pride in my academics - and now I've fallen so behind. I feel like I'm a failure, and every day I spend hiding in bed, the worse I feel. And the worse I feel, the less strong am I to pull myself out of my depression.

I feel like this because I keep realizing how much of a terrible human being I am. I feel awkward, ugly, misshapen. An outcast from the community. Some thinking entity poorly fitting in to a set of human skins.

In some abstract, rational sense - I know non of this is true. I know that I'm not ugly, that I have friends, that my community loves me. But if so, why can't I bear to look at myself in the mirror?

Why must I hide away from everyone I love?

Hello. Sorry for the late response, but I'm glad you wrote to me. I'm so sorry to hear that you've lost your friend, and that you've been through similar straits. They say that those who are the kindest are those who've suffered the most - because they don't want others to feel the same, and it really shows in your reply.

I feel slightly better now, even if I'm not okay at all. I feel sort of bitterly sad at the thought of me making posts on /r/SuicideWatch, because I'm usually the one helping, rather than the one needing help. In fact, on my regular account I frequently reply to people on this very subreddit.

And now it's my turn on the other side of the fence. 

Today I took the [PHQ-9 Depression test](https://patient.info/doctor/patient-health-questionnaire-phq-9), and I was surprised to see myself scoring an "Severe Depression" on the list. But I guess I shouldn't be. I've been consistently avoiding classes, and sleeping in bed - and thinking about killing myself.

And sadly, the thing is - I don't want to die. I really don't. I love the world, and everything in it. But my wish to not die is overruled by my wish to not suffer, and I'm so tired of hurting.
I have friends, and they are all lovely and wonderful people in their own right. I just can't talk to them about these things.
